description: A `struct` type name colliding with a built-in primitive raises `ol-reserved-word` at phase-1 registration (issue #329, `spec/data-structures.md:304,323`): `forward` is a Turtle & Rendering primitive, so `struct forward` cannot register a constructor of that name. Note the profile set here is Core + Data only: the rule is unconditional (`spec/grammar.md`'s declaration-slot rule, ruling #833 rule 4), so a Turtle name is a built-in name whether or not Turtle & Rendering is claimed.

diagnostics.message: forward is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
